Market today: The mood is cautious. The real driver is rising interest rates and the Fed's hawkish stance, with the 10-year Treasury yield hitting highs not seen since 2007. This environment typically hurts growth-oriented tech/chip names, especially those held on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-59.02%) and SPAL (-35.65%) are in dire straits. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying, and showing massive drawdowns. Margin amplifies these drops, making them critical concerns. QQQ (-1.13%) and SMH (-14.36%) are also on TRIM status.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further Fed commentary and Treasury yield movements. Any indication of sustained higher rates will continue to pressure your core holdings.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management, particularly on your leveraged and underperforming positions, in a rising rate environment.
plays: SOXL and SPAL are deep in the red and leveraged. Consider cutting losses on these volatile positions, especially with margin amplifying drops.
CRWD is performing well (+31.42%). Scanner suggests ACCUMULATE at 234.34-233.34 with a stop at 231.64. This could be a good addition to a winning position.
QQQ and SMH are on TRIM status. With rising rates, consider reducing exposure to these core tech/chip holdings to manage risk.
